properties.evidence: The earlier observation saw the same shape one layer down. It found that one RocksDB store serves every git branch, so two branches share a live graph — and its sharpest note is that `parallel-work`'s trigger conditions are framed by PEOPLE, so the solo maintainer with two branches, who hits the identical collision, is the reader the skill excludes. Same failure family: the machinery for keeping two lines of work apart exists, and what neither the store nor the skill carries is whether a line of work is FINISHED.
